governance.name: MCP Joins the Agentic AI Foundation (official MCP blog)
governance.description: Anthropic donated MCP to the Agentic AI Foundation (AAIF), a directed fund under the Linux Foundation, effective 2025-12-09. Existing maintainers keep full technical authority via the SEP process; the foundation provides neutral governance infrastructure and does not set technical direction. Founding members: Anthropic, Block, OpenAI, with AWS, Google, Microsoft, Cloudflare, Bloomberg support. Verified 2026-07-11

official_client_docs.name: anthropics/claude-code issue #40314 (HTTP tools not deferred)
official_client_docs.description: Confirmed, closed-as-not-planned gap: ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH does not reliably defer Streamable HTTP MCP tool schemas, observed loading ~120K tokens (60% of a 200K context) upfront for a ~250-tool HTTP gateway even with auto:5 set. Verified 2026-07-11
